'''Kato''' (Japanese: '''カンタ''' ''Kanta'') is one of the two characters {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} meet in the beginning of ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]''.

==In the movies==
Kato, along with [[Kiko]], battled Ash and Dawn for their watermelons. Later, they advised Ash and his friends to see the ruins of their [[Michina Town|town]]. Later on, after Ash and his friends return from the corrected past, with {{OBP|Arceus|M12}} subsequently recognizing Ash from the past events and restoring the destruction, Kato and Kiko were seen witnessing the regeneration of the bridge's structure. Kato and Kiko later made a brief appearance in the ending credits, where they are seen eating corn on the back of a tractor.
